State Newton's second law of motion.
questions.answer: The rate of change of momentum of a body is proportional to the applied force and takes place in the direction of the force (F = ma).

questions.question: Define one farad of capacitance.
questions.answer: A capacitor has a capacitance of one farad when one coulomb of charge raises the potential difference between its plates by one volt.
